tools.name: scan_niche_demand
tools.description: Scan YouTube, Reddit, and Hacker News to compute live content demand gap scores and Views-Per-Hour (VPH) outliers. Free accounts include 5 scans per year within a 30-day window; paid accounts include 100 scans per day resetting at 00:00.

tools.name: predict_hook_retention
tools.description: Analyze opening 30-second video hooks to predict audience retention curves (0-100 score) and script optimization recommendations. Counts toward your scan quota (5/year free, 100/day paid resetting at 00:00).

tools.name: synthesize_omnichannel_assets
tools.description: Generate Twitter/X threads, LinkedIn posts, and high-CTR title variations from a validated YouTube outlier. Counts toward your scan quota (5/year free, 100/day paid resetting at 00:00).
